title: The Black Swan
author: Nassim Nicholas Taleb
summary: Taleb argues that rare, unpredictable events shape history, markets and our lives far more than we admit, and that we fool ourselves with stories and forecasts that ignore them.
readIf: you enjoy opinionated, wide-ranging arguments about risk and uncertainty.
skipIf: you dislike abrasive authors who dismiss experts and repeat their central point.
